snippet.title: Players Already Found Bigfoot in GTA 6 🎮
snippet.description:
GTA 6 has been out for a few hours and players have already found Bigfoot.

This isn't a mod or a fake clip. It's a secret scene inside the game. In the Leonida wilds you first hear a loud roar, and Jason follows its tracks. He reaches a weird tree and blacks out on the spot. Then a cutscene plays: a big hairy creature slowly walks up to Jason.

And Rockstar didn't go with a normal Bigfoot here. It's the Skunk Ape, Florida's own Bigfoot.

Players have been hunting Bigfoot in GTA since the San Andreas days, and GTA 6 gave it to them on day one.

Which GTA 6 secret are you going to find first? Tell us in the comments.

Sources:
- Kotaku, GTA 6 launch live blog, 18 Nov 2026 (a player found Bigfoot in the swamps of Leonida): https://kotaku.com/live-updates-on-gta-6-the-biggest-launch-in-gaming-history-2000758030
- VGTimes, "Players have already found Bigfoot in Grand Theft Auto 6" (roar, tracks, strange tree, blackout, cutscene; Rockstar used Florida's Skunk Ape): https://vgtimes.com/gaming-news/175042-players-have-already-found-bigfoot-in-grand-theft-auto-6.html
- Clip: GameClips (YouTube), "GTA 6 Bigfoot Scene", 18 Nov 2026: https://youtu.be/Cyo8KD_Lkfw ; used for news commentary
- Footage: Rockstar Games (official Grand Theft Auto VI screenshots, rockstargames.com/VI); used for news commentary

#GTA6 #GTAVI #Bigfoot #SkunkApe #gaming #Shorts

MUITAS PROMOÇÕES INCRÍVEIS!
https://mercadolivre.com/sec/1zKKhwS

Sobre o encontro misterioso de Davy Jones com uma possível criatura semelhante ao Pé Grande em GTA 6! Durante a exploração de Grand Theft Auto VI, Davy escuta barulhos estranhos, percebe algo se movimentando pelo cenário e decide investigar o que está acontecendo.

Ao se aproximar do local, Davy encontra uma figura misteriosa e começa a questionar se realmente está diante do lendário Pé Grande. Surpreso com a situação, ele tenta entender o que acabou de descobrir e se é possível enfrentar ou eliminar a criatura.

Na sequência, o encontro fica ainda mais estranho, provocando reações de espanto e confusão. Davy tenta localizar novamente o ponto onde tudo aconteceu e comenta as situações inesperadas que já está encontrando pelo mundo aberto de GTA 6.

Por fim, a exploração continua com novas surpresas, incluindo a aparição de um jacaré, enquanto Davy demonstra empolgação com os mistérios e as descobertas espalhadas pelo jogo.

snippet.title: GTA 6 BIGFOOT SIGHTING (real)
snippet.description:
I FLEW TO NEW ZEALAND TO PLAY GTA VI AND SAW BIGFOOT??

Playing Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) live on launch day! Join me as we start the game with Lucia and Jason in the neon-soaked state of Leonida. Full story playthrough, no spoilers in chat. (PlayStation 5 Pro)

GTA 6 officially launches November 19, 2026 on PlayStation 5 (PS5 Pro Enhanced) and Xbox Series X|S. Set in the sun-soaked, neon-drenched world of Vice City and Leonida, the game follows protagonists Lucia and Jason through heists, high-speed chases, and Rockstar’s signature open-world storytelling.

Like the video if you're excited for GTA 6!
